vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Full time Graduate plus CA/ICWAI. Experience required: Experience in Finance & Accounts with IND-AS, Finalization of Accounts, GST, Income Tax, Internal & Statutory Audit, Banking and Treasury, Billing, Vetting of proposals, with knowledge of Tally, MS Office, ERP, Tenders & Contracts. Must be working in PB-2 + GP4200 (Level 6) for 2 years, or IDA Rs. 40000-140000 / Rs. 30000-120000 for 2 years, or in a private company at Deputy Manager level or above with gross salary of at least Rs. 50 thousand per month, at least 4 years executive experience and company turnover of at least Rs. 75 Crs. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Deputy Manager (Finance)/E1, 1 Deputy Manager (Mechanical)/E1.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II of this PDF (for absorption)) and send it to Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010, by by post / courier or dropped personally, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years (as on 4 December 2026). Relaxation: Employees presently working on the rolls of IPRCL Over and above the upper age limit to the extent of their service period rendered in IPRCL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: IDA Scale of pay: Rs. 40000-140000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP (for IDA as per Policy). for Deputy Manager (Finance)/E1, IDA Scale of pay: Rs. 40000-140000 + Applicable Allowances + PRP (for IDA as per Policy). for Deputy Manager (Mechanical)/E1.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dy. Manager (Finance)/E1: Full time Graduate plus CA/ICWAI. Dy. Manager (Mechanical)/E1: Full time Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Both posts also need the required experience and must be presently working in Railways, Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control or a Private Company at the prescribed level. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be presently working on regular (on absorption) or contract basis in Railways, Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control or Private Company. Higher grade pay or pay scale granted under ACP/MACP/NF is not counted for eligibility. Applicant should be physically and medically fit; medical examination on selection as per corporation's policy. Only Indian citizens may apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose documents mismatch or who cannot produce original documents will not be allowed to appear in the Personal Interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on eligibility/experience in the relevant field (ratio 1:5 when there are 5 or more eligible candidates per vacancy). Personal Interview. Personal Interview may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C. or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion. With 5 or more eligible candidates per vacancy, shortlisting in the ratio 1:5 based on eligibility and experience.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on absorption. Three-month advance notice required before resignation. Service conditions regulated by Offer of Appointment, HR Policies and orders of IPRCL.
